Thank you for this pull request, and for the time you've put into Plyr.

Plyr is deprecated and receives security updates only, so we're closing pull requests that don't fix a security issue, and this one won't be merged.

The folks behind Plyr, Vidstack and Media Chrome now work on [Video.js 10](https://videojs.org?utm_source=plyr). If this change applies there, we'd love a pull request or issue in [videojs/video.js](https://github.com/videojs/video.js). The migration guide shows where Plyr concepts live in Video.js 10: [HTML](https://videojs.org/docs/framework/html/guides/migrate-from-plyr?utm_source=plyr) · [React](https://videojs.org/docs/framework/react/guides/migrate-from-plyr?utm_source=plyr).

If this fixes a security vulnerability, comment here and we'll review it. For a vulnerability that isn't public yet, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/sampotts/plyr/blob/master/SECURITY.md) instead.
